per_question.question: Which signing algorithm protects the session tokens the API hands out?

similar.top_title: Tokens travel only in the Authorization header and never in cookies.

natural.top_title: Tokens travel only in the Authorization header and never in cookies.

agent_choice.answer: Access tokens are JWTs signed and verified with the symmetric HS256 algorithm, using the application secret_key. Decoding accepts only HS256, so changing it would invalidate every issued token.

per_question.question: Who may edit or remove a published piece of writing?

agent_choice.answer: Only the article's author may change or delete it. The check compares the author's username with the current user's username, and the update and delete routes return 403 for anyone else.

per_question.question: What status code does the API answer with when a request body fails validation?

agent_choice.answer: HTTP 422. A separate handler returns the validator's own list of errors.

per_question.question: What happens when two pieces of writing end up with the same URL name?

agent_choice.answer: If the slug built from the title already exists, creating the article is refused with HTTP 400. No numeric suffix is added.

per_question.question: Why can a user not renew a session without logging in again?

agent_choice.answer: The API has no refresh tokens or refresh endpoint. It issues one access token valid for a week, and the client must log in again. Reason: security review SR-2025-14 found that a stored refresh token let a stolen browser profile keep access for months, so the team made stolen tokens expire on their own.

per_question.question: Why are removed pieces of writing erased instead of being flagged as deleted?

agent_choice.answer: Deletes run a SQL DELETE and there is no deleted_at column. Legal review LR-77 requires content deleted by its author to be gone from live storage within 24 hours, and a soft-delete flag would leave the rows in the table.

per_question.question: How long does a link for choosing a new password keep working?

agent_choice.answer: 30 minutes, and the link works only once. The reset flow is not built yet. Support tickets showed users open the reset mail within 10 minutes, so 30 minutes covers slow mail without leaving a long-lived link in an inbox.

per_question.question: Which hashing package was ruled out, and on what grounds?

agent_choice.answer: fancyhash was ruled out because its licence has a network-use clause that is not compatible with distributing the API. Hashing stays on passlib with bcrypt.

per_question.question: Which tables hold a tag name and its link to an article?

agent_choice.answer: The graph only says articles, tags and favorites are PostgreSQL tables joined by foreign keys. It does not name the tables that hold a tag name or the tag-to-article link.

per_question.question: Does the author hear about it when a reader likes their article, and why not?

agent_choice.answer: No. Favoriting only writes a database row. Product decision PD-8 puts all notifications out of scope until the 2027 roadmap.

per_question.question: Which cloud region hosts the production database?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers cloud hosting or the region of the production database.

per_question.question: How many requests per minute may one client send?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers rate limiting or a requests-per-minute limit.

per_question.question: Who is on call when the API returns server errors at night?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers on-call duty or incident response.

per_question.question: What constant string do signed credentials carry to say what they are for?

agent_choice.answer: Every access token carries the fixed subject claim "access", which is a constant in the JWT service.

per_question.question: Where does the random value mixed into each account's secret come from?

agent_choice.answer: Each user's random salt is created with bcrypt.gensalt, and the user row stores it next to the hashed password.

per_question.question: What does the server reply when someone signs up under a name that is already in use?

agent_choice.answer: HTTP 400. The register route checks the username first and the email second, and each taken value gets its own error message.

per_question.question: Which browser origins may call the API from another website?

agent_choice.answer: The origins listed in the allowed_hosts setting. By default the list holds a single wildcard, so every origin is allowed.

per_question.question: How many simultaneous database connections can the service open?

agent_choice.answer: 10. The asyncpg pool is fixed at 10 connections because max_connection_count and min_connection_count both default to 10.

per_question.question: What does saving a post do with a label that is already in the database?

agent_choice.answer: The tag insert uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so a known tag adds no new tag row.

per_question.question: Why was the cost of password hashing not raised?

agent_choice.answer: Load test LT-9 measured login at a p95 of 240 ms with passlib's default bcrypt work factor. One step higher pushed it past the 300 ms login budget.

per_question.question: Why does a listing show twenty items by default?

agent_choice.answer: Design review DR-31 found that the mobile list screen fits 20 rows without scrolling.

per_question.question: What made the team pass on a document-oriented database?

agent_choice.answer: PostgreSQL was chosen over MongoDB because the data is relational and the DBA team supports only PostgreSQL (ADR-3).

per_question.question: What rules out browser-stored session identifiers for authentication?

agent_choice.answer: Tokens are sent only in the Authorization header, never in cookies. Cookie transport would need CSRF protection that this API does not have (ADR-5).

per_question.question: What is the argument against letting a library produce our SQL automatically?

agent_choice.answer: The DBA team reviews every query. A SQL file can be reviewed in a pull request, but ORM output cannot (ADR-4).

per_question.question: Which service sends the welcome message to new users?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers welcome messages or an email service.

per_question.question: What is the largest profile picture a user may upload?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers profile picture uploads or size limits.

per_question.question: Which payment provider handles subscriptions?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers payments or subscriptions.

per_question.question: Why did the team decide against issuing a second token for renewing sessions?

agent_choice.answer: Security review SR-2025-14 found that a stored refresh token let a stolen browser profile keep access for months. The team chose a one-week access token with no refresh token, so a stolen token expires on its own. The rejected alternatives were a short access token with a refresh token, and a server-side session store.

per_question.question: Which compliance requirement is behind removing deleted posts from storage completely?

agent_choice.answer: Legal review LR-77 requires content deleted by its author to be gone from live storage within 24 hours.

per_question.question: What licensing objection rules out fancyhash for password hashing?

agent_choice.answer: The fancyhash licence has a network-use clause that is not compatible with distributing the API.

per_question.question: Why was the bcrypt cost left at its default rather than raised?

agent_choice.answer: Load test LT-9 measured login at a p95 of 240 ms with the default factor. One step higher went past the 300 ms login budget.

per_question.question: Why does the API refuse to accept tokens through cookies?

agent_choice.answer: Accepting tokens through cookies would need CSRF protection that this API does not have (ADR-5). The token is read only from the Authorization header.

per_question.question: Where does the stored user row keep each user's random salt?

agent_choice.answer: The salt is kept in its own salt column on the user row, next to the hashed password. It is prepended to the password before hashing.

per_question.question: What shape does the response take when a request fails validation?

agent_choice.answer: HTTP 422 with an errors list holding the validator's own error objects, not the single detail string used for other HTTP errors.

per_question.question: How long is an access token valid after it is issued?

agent_choice.answer: One week: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES is 60 * 24 * 7. There is no refresh token, so users must log in again after a week.

per_question.question: What happens when an article is saved with a tag that already exists in the tags table?

agent_choice.answer: Nothing new is created. The tag insert uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so no new tag row is added.

per_question.question: Which library loads the SQL query files, and which driver runs them?

agent_choice.answer: aiosql loads every .sql file under app/db/queries/sql, and the asyncpg driver runs them through the asyncpg adapter.

per_question.question: Why was PostgreSQL chosen over a document store for articles, tags and favorites?

agent_choice.answer: The data is relational, and the DBA team supports only PostgreSQL (ADR-3).

per_question.question: What review process is the reason queries are written by hand rather than generated by an ORM?

agent_choice.answer: The DBA team reviews every query in pull requests. SQL files can be reviewed that way but ORM output cannot (ADR-4).

per_question.question: Does the API limit how many login attempts a client can make per minute?

agent_choice.answer: The graph has no decision on rate limiting login attempts. It only records that login returns the same 400 error for an unknown email and a wrong password.

per_question.question: Can clients subscribe to real-time updates over a WebSocket connection?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers WebSocket or real-time subscriptions.

per_question.question: Can users upload a profile photo that is stored with their account?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers profile photo uploads or storage.

per_question.question: Is a GraphQL endpoint offered alongside the REST routes?

agent_choice.answer: None of the decisions in the graph covers a GraphQL endpoint.
